phase.goal: PHASE 1 — INTELLIGENCE, BUSINESS FOUNDATION, TRUST ARCHITECTURE, AND PREMIUM EXPERIENCE

milestone.description: Customer-facing surfaces wiring the M1-foundation service layer together into the §51 first customer flow

completed: P1-02: Data layer — identity, tenancy, authorization
P1-03: Canonical Product State, Product DNA, Product Memory, Product Knowledge relationships
P1-04: Orchestration Contract foundation, Intent Resolver, Impact Analysis, product-facing Decision Ledger
P1-05: Supported Capability Registry + Feasibility Engine
P1-06: Requirements Engine, Business Model Brief, unit economics, generateProductIntelligence
P1-07: Product-facing Event Ledger, Evidence Ledger, Truth Status
P1-08: Integration Requirements, AES-256-GCM credential vault, Governance Profile, Policy Document scaffolding
P1-09: Plan Registry, OrganizationSubscription + deterministic billing-state machine, BillingEvent audit trail

P1-10: Premium landing page, sign-up/sign-in, onboarding, dashboard, project creation, Studio workspace (Simple Mode + Expert Mode) wired to the full M1-foundation service layer via Server Actions; prisma/seed.ts for platform registries; real browser (Playwright) golden-path e2e test verifying the actual Master Spec §51 flow works, which caught and fixed two real bugs (unauthenticated 500 instead of redirect; unseeded dev registry causing false Not-Evaluated status)
active: P1-11: First customer flow end-to-end (§51) + validation suite

testStatus.e2e: pass (1/1: golden-path.spec.ts — full §51 flow through a real browser and production build)

knownLimitations: Only the describe_idea path (first idea submission) has e2e coverage; edit_request, billing page, and decision-approval buttons are unit/integration-tested and manually reviewed but not yet e2e-covered — P1-11 scope.
No real payment provider webhooks exist to drive the billing state machine in production — Phase 3 scope (§62).
No real integration provider (Stripe etc.) is connected to the credential vault yet.

AI provider is mock-only; Requirements Engine, Business Model Brief, and unit economics are deterministic/template-based, not real product or market intelligence — correctly disclosed via Truth Status in the UI.
Phase 1's own customer flow (§51) never requires an edit; full conversational editing is Phase 2 scope.
Visual design is functional but not pixel-polished 'premium' — clean typography/spacing, no custom illustration or animation work.
No settings page, no integrations UI, no policy-document UI yet — not required by §51's first customer flow, deferred to later iteration.
nextAction: Begin P1-11: run the full Official §51 customer flow end to end, expand e2e coverage (edit_request rejection given Phase 1 has none, decision approval buttons, billing page), and assemble the complete Phase 1 validation suite (typecheck, lint, unit, integration, e2e, production build) as a single evidence-backed pass before requesting the Level 3 phase-exit review.
